scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ztype/web" "npm run dev -w @ztype/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ztype/web && npm run build -w @ztype/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api
scripts.test:emulators: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/firebase-cli.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-ztype --only auth,firestore "npm run test:integration"
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.emulator.config.ts
